text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold winners quickly, then bought some back at higher prices; I should base exits on the investment outlook and a plan, not the satisfaction of locking in a gain.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me cling to losing positions or resist admitting a mistake; I should judge each holding by its prospects and contribution to my whole portfolio, not its purchase price.","Before trading, set clear buy, hold, and sell criteria and consider risk and diversification; frequent checking should not turn short-term price moves into impulsive decisions."]}
